Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players stride out to the middle. Shamima Sultana and Sharmin Akhter are the openers for Bangladesh Women. Shabnim Ismail to start with the ball. Let's go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! The bowlers of Bangladesh Women have done their job. It is onto their batters now to chase this decent target against a quality bowling side of South Africa Women. Can Bangladesh Women chase it down and kickstart their campaign with a victory? Stay tuned to find that out as the chase will begin shortly.

Marizanne Kapp is up for a quick chat. She says that they knew Bangladesh have a lot of spinners and it was always going to be difficult for them to adjust to their pace. Tells that they are 20-30 runs short and should have done well with the bat. Mentions that they have runs on the board and must bowl well now to get a win here.

Bangladesh Women started impressively keeping it tight from both ends and Fariha Trisna ultimately got the early breakthrough they were looking for. They kept the pressure on and didn't allow the runs to come easy. Wolvaardt's wicket was the key for them as after that they kept chipping in with crucial wickets. Fariha Trisna was the pick of the bowlers as she finished with 3 wickets and was very economical as well. Other bowlers also chipped in nicely and were very economical. Except Nahida Akter, everyone got atleast a wicket and they will be mighty pleased with their efforts.

South Africa Women had a pretty sedate start where Laura Wolvaardt did most of the scoring while Tazmin Brits found it very tough to get going. She was dropped on a duck but could not make the most of the lifeline and departed early. Wolvaardt was moving along nicely but after she got out, the batters just came in and went back making little contributions. Marizanne Kapp and Chloe Tryon did stitch a crucial partnership and steadied the ship for a while but once the latter got out, things went downhill and South Africa Women didn't quite get the finish they were looking for.

Making their maiden appearance in Cricket World Cup, Bangladesh Women have put up a solid show and will be very proud of themselves. They controlled most part of the game and were hardly put under pressure and have done well here to restrict South Africa Women to 207. For the Proteas, no one was able to convert their starts and have ended up with a below par total.

OUT! STUMPED! Ritu Moni gets her second wicket and that is it for South Africa Women. Ayabonga Khaka advances down the track to this length ball and has a wild swing at it. She misses and Shamima Sultana behind the sticks collects the ball cleanly to whip the bails off. Ayabonga Khaka has no chance of getting back in the crease and South Africa Women are bowled out for 207.

OUT! RUN OUT! What an unfortunate way to get out. Yesterday, Suzie Bates got out in a similar fashion in the first game of the tournament and this time it's Sune Luus. Rumana Ahmed bowls a loopy ball, on middle. Marizanne Kapp stays back and knocks it back to the bowler. Rumana Ahmed dives to her right and gets a hand to it before the ball hits the stumps. She appeals for a run out and the umpire takes it upstairs but Sune Luus knew it straightaway and already started walking back. Replay rolls in and it shows that the ball deflected off the bowler's fingertips. Bangladesh Women chipping away with timely wickets. South Africa Women have lost half of their side now.

Is that a run out? Did the bowler get a hand on it? The decision has been sent upstairs and the replays roll in. It shows that the ball deflected off the bowler's fingertips. However, Sune Luus was already walked off the field and she is in the pavilion..

On a good length, on off. Lara Goodall pushes it to mid on.
On a length, on off. Lara Goodall clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, driven towards covers. The fielder dives to her right to make the stop but the batters take a single.
Slower delivery, outside off, at 89 kph. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to point.
Touch fuller, on off. Laura Wolvaardt drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
WIDE! Full and down leg, Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick. Wided.
Fuller in length, on off. Driven to mid off.
On the pads, worked away to square leg for a run.
Full and outside off, Goodall drives it nicely but straight to cover.
FOUR LEG BYES! Length ball angling down the leg side, Lara Goodall looks to flick but misses. The ball brushes her pads and goes past the diving keeper to the fine leg fence.
On a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt steers it through covers for a single.
End of Powerplay 1! Bangladesh Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over.
A full ball, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt works it wide of mid on and takes a single.
A length ball, around off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it towards mid off.
Another shout for LBW but the umpire says no! Back of a length, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick and gets hit high on her pad yet again.
On a length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt pushes it to covers but not in the gap.
An appeal for LBW but turned down! Good-length delivery, jagging back in from middle. Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick and gets hit high on her pad.
An overpitched ball, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt flicks it through square leg and comes back for the second run.
A full ball, angling across the batter. Lara Goodall lets it sail through to the keeper. A maiden over from Jahanara Alam.
Back of a length, outside off. Lara Goodall looks to cut but she gets an underedge that falls just wide of the sticks and goes towards the keeper.
Good-length ball, angling in from middle. Lara Goodall covers the line of the ball and blocks it.
Full and outside off. Lara Goodall lets it through to the keeper.
BEATEN! A full ball, just outside off. Lara Goodall looks to drive but the ball sneaks through her bat and pad.
A length ball, around off. Lara Goodall prods and defends it out.
Nigar Sultana is getting some treatment on her knee. She is fine now and we are ready to resume.
Trisna drifts it onto the pads. Lara Goodall clips it behind square on the leg side and takes a single to get off the mark.
This is a good-length ball, on middle. Lara Goodall blocks it off the front foot.
Back of a length, outside off. Lara Goodall leaves it alone.
Wide! Trisna spills it down leg. Lara Goodall lets it be and the umpire calls it as a wide.
A yorker-length ball, on off. Lara Goodall digs it out.
Lara Goodall walks out to bat at no.3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fariha Trisna strikes and Bangladesh Women get the breakthrough. Trisna has been bowling well and finally gets rewarded! This was a full ball, on middle that jagged back in late. Brits looks to flick but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards Rumana Ahmed at mid-wicket who takes a simple catch moving to her right.
Commentary.Howout: c Rumana Ahmed b Fariha Trisna

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, angling in from middle. Tazmin Brits looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid on.
FOUR! Now that spoils a good over! Alam serves a juicy half-volley, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt carves it through covers and bags a boundary.
An overpitched ball, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt gets forward and digs it out towards the mid off fielder. Five dots in a row!
On a length, around middle. Laura Wolvaardt eases it to mid on.
Fuller and wider, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt drives but straight to the point fielder.
A stifled appeal for caught behind but the umpire says no! A full ball, angling down leg. Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick and the ball brushes her pad before going to the keeper.
Good-length delivery, around off. Laura Wolvaardt prods and defends it to the off side.
Back of a length, around middle. Tazmin Brits tucks it around the corner and does well to come back for the second run.
Fuller in length, on middle. Brits skips down the track a bit and manages to chip it just over the mid on fielder for a couple of runs.
A full ball, nipping back in late from middle and leg. Tazmin Brits looks to flick but she misses and gets hit on her pad.
FOUR! Tazmin Brits breaks the shackles and finally gets off the mark! A full ball, on middle. Brits heaves it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Another ball, on a length and angling in from off. Laura Wolvaardt covers the line of the ball and nudges it to the leg side for a run.
A length ball, around the fourth stump channel. Laura Wolvaardt hangs back and blocks it out.
Once again Brits punches this back-of-a-length ball to the cover fielder. She has faced 18 deliveries and is yet to get off the mark.
Can't get it through! Back of a length, outside off, was a freebie Brits was looking for but she punches it straight to the cover fielder.
WIDE! A wayward delivery down the leg side. Left alone.
On a length, on off. Brits looks to work it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Fuller in length, on off. Tazmin Brits prods and drives it to mid off.
Back of a length, on off. Brits guides it to point.
Fuller, on off, shaping away. Laura Wolvaardt covers the line and works it behind point for a single.
Length, on middle. Brits defends it down onto the deck.
Tazmin Brits advances down the track and tries to flick this length ball but gets hit on the pads.
Good-length ball, on off. Brits works it to mid on.
Full and on middle, nicely nudged to mid-wicket with soft hands for a run.
FOUR! Lovely shot! On a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt punches it straight down the ground off the back foot. The ball races away to the long off fence.
On a good length, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt knocks it back to the bowler.

Nicely bowled! On a good length, outside off, nipping away. Tazmin Brits looks to push but pulls out at the end moment as she is taken aback by the swing and bounce and lets it sail through. She is yet to get off the mark.
Length ball, outside off. Brits pushes it towards covers.
Good-length ball, on middle. Tazmin Brits keeps it out on the leg side.

On a good length, outside off, nipping away. Tazmin Brits steers it to backward point. She wants a single but is sent back by Laura Wolvaardt. The fielder throws the ball to the keeper in a jiffy and she whips the bails off but Tazmin Brits made it home in time.
On a length, on off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to defend. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Width offered again, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt punches it through covers for a brace.

Nicely bowled! Length ball, on middle and leg, jagging back in. Tazmin Brits looks to work it on the leg side but misses and gets struck on the pads. Fariha Trisna appeals for an lbw but the umpire says no. They do not opt for the review.
WIDE! Length ball going down leg. Tazmin Brits lets it go. Wide given.
On a length, on middle. Worked to square leg.
Length ball, on middle. Brits shimmies down and works it on the leg side.
Good-length ball, on middle. Tucked to square leg.

DROPPED! Oh dear! Fuller in length, on off. Tazmin Brits chips it off the toe end of the bat to mid on. It goes straight into the hands of the fielder but the player fails to hold onto it. Fariha Trisna is not at all happy. An early life to Tazmin Brits.
Length ball, on middle, swinging in. Tazmin Brits defends it out.
Who will operate from the other end? Fariha Trisna it is.
Well bowled! Good-length ball, shaping away, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt looks to defend but misses. The ball goes past the outside edge. 6 runs from the first over.
Fuller in length, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt leands and drives it to cover.
Touch fuller, on middle. Laura Wolvaardt presses forward and defends it to cover.
Length ball, on off. Nicely driven by Laura Wolvaardt but straight to cover.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Width on offer, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt takes full advantage of it. She guides it through cover-point once again but this time the ball races away to the fence.

South Africa Women get underway and Laura Wolvaardt is off the mark straightaway! Jahanara Alam starts with a length ball, outside off. Laura Wolvaardt punches it through cover-point for a couple of runs.

We are done with the national anthems and are set for the game to begin. The players of Bangladesh Women stride out to the middle. Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits to open the batting for South Africa Women. Jahanara Alam will start with the ball. Before the first ball is bowled, the players take knee to support the Black Lives Matter movement.

We are moments away from live-action. The match officials and both teams line up for their respective national anthems. But before that, they observe a moment of silence in the memory of two Australian greats - Rod Marsh and Shane Warne. Both teams and the match officials are wearing black arm-bands. South Africa's National anthem will be played first followed by that of Bangladesh.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Shamima Sultana, Sharmin Akhter, Fargana Hoque, Nigar Sultana (C/WK), Rumana Ahmed, Murshida Khatun, Ritu Moni, Salma Khatun, Nahida Akter, Fariha Trisna, Jahanara Alam.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Laura Wolvaardt, Sune Luus (C), Lara Goodall, Mignon du Preez, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Marizanne Kapp, Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Masabata Klaas.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Bangladesh Women. They have elected to BOWL first.

South Africa Women looks more settled and strong compared to their opponents. They are considered as one of the title contenders but have their own issues as well. They are also coming on the back of two losses in the warm-up games and will also miss the services of Lizelle Lee in their opening game. Other players need to step up in her absence. South Africa Women would look to start their campaign with nothing but a victory but Bangladesh Women have a resourceful side to fall back on. Let's see who comes out on top. Toss and team news in a bit.

Bangladesh Women haven't enjoyed good fortunes in recent times as they are entering the World Cup on the back of two losses in the warm-up fixtures. They have to be on their toes in their opening game. They need to be at their absolute best if they are to give a tough fight against the likes of the Proteas and kickstart their campaign on a positive note.

The ICC Women's Cricket World Cup has officially got underway and in Match 2 we will see South Africa Women lock horns against Bangladesh Women. South Africa Women will eye a maiden world title after having finished twice as the semifinalists in the 2000 and 2017 editions. On the other hand, Bangladesh Women are making a maiden World Cup appearance and would look to make their presence felt and leave no stone unturned. On that note, a warm welcome to the coverage.
